name: Andile Jaden Mbele
status: Open to software, data, DevOps and security roles
positioning: I build secure, data-heavy systems, from 40B-record pipelines to AI tooling.
summary: Software engineer working in Go, Python, TypeScript and Rust across security, data, infrastructure and AI. Founding Engineer at TraceGraph.
about: I turn recurring engineering work into platforms: the systems, automation, and observability that help teams ship faster without trading away reliability.
Most of how I build comes from a short shelf of books, a longer stack of papers, and systems that broke in production. Right now that means distributed systems and evals for AI agents.
Self-taught. I love engineering, code, coffee, data and rockets.
availability: Open to full-time and contract work as a Software, Data, DevOps, or AI systems engineer, a Threat Intelligence Analyst, or a founding engineer, from Senior to Principal. Also consulting, speaking, and advising early-stage teams.

openTo.title: Software Engineer
openTo.focus: Senior to Principal. Backend, platform, and product engineering in Go, Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Java.
openTo.evidence: Built Atlas, which seats nearly 2,000 people across three countries, and cut its page loads from 15–20 API calls to one or two.

openTo.title: Data Engineer
openTo.focus: Pipelines and data platforms for data too large or too messy for off-the-shelf tools.
openTo.evidence: Built pipelines that moved 40B+ records, with streaming, encoding recovery, and schema normalisation across SQL, JSON, CSV, and XML.

openTo.title: DevOps Engineer
openTo.focus: Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and the automation that keeps deploys boring.
openTo.evidence: Operated a four-region AWS platform of 37 ECS services and 50+ repositories, with the deployment, inventory, and alerting automation around it.

openTo.title: Threat Intelligence Analyst
openTo.focus: Advisories, attack surface, and email security, backed by tools I write.
openTo.evidence: Sentinel matches GHSA, OSV, NVD, and CISA KEV against every SBOM and surfaced 5,000+ findings; domainwatch, spoofscore, and dmarc-ready show what attackers see.

openTo.title: AI systems engineer
openTo.focus: Agents, retrieval, and evals that hold up in production.
openTo.evidence: Rumi narrows 4,600 postings a day to a shortlist for under a dollar a run. Now building a public benchmark of agentic software-engineering tasks.

openTo.title: Founding or early engineer
openTo.focus: Security, data, or AI teams going from zero to one.
openTo.evidence: Founding Engineer at TraceGraph and at Vectra Dynamics, and Lead Engineer at Optimeer Labs.

proof.label: records through pipelines I have built

principles.title: Turn repeated work into a platform
principles.body: When a team does the same thing for the third time, I build the system, automation, or check that does it for them.

principles.title: Design for how data is read
principles.body: Reliability and speed come from the shape of the data and its access paths. Atlas got fast when the API matched the screen, not the tables.

principles.title: Every claim links to evidence
principles.body: A number, an incident, or a verdict should trace back to the record it came from, so anyone can check it. TraceGraph and Rumi are both built on that.
principles.source: Hoare, An Axiomatic Basis for Computer Programming
